summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, reporting a news release dated May 21, 2026, announcing an extension of 4,633,965 warrants issued in a 2024 non-brokered private placement. The warrants, with exercise prices unchanged at $0.90, had original expirations from late May to mid-June 2026 and are extended one year to 2027. No other terms are altered; the Canadian Securities Exchange granted an exemption for the extension. This is a routine warrant amendment, not a special situation. Watch for no further developments.
